**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle null names in delegated defineClass calls**

When `ClassLoader#defineClass(null, ByteBuffer, ...)` is invoked with a heap buffer, the JDK delegates to the also-instrumented byte-array overload while retaining the null name. This guard makes `isDefining` return false for that legal input, so the nested callback still parses the class and loads its supertypes a second time instead of being suppressed as intended; track enough identity to recognize unnamed delegations without conflating unrelated unnamed definitions.
